_comment: Example .claude/settings.json wiring for the three hooks in hooks/, for a project that wants to copy the scripts directly instead of installing this directory as a Claude Code plugin. Adjust the paths if you place them somewhere other than ci/. GATES_MAIN_BRANCH configures main-branch-rule.sh, GATES_VERIFY_COMMAND the command finish-the-work.sh asks for; watch-pipeline.sh needs no configuration but does need curl, jq and a GitHub origin.
